title: Manager: a park reason for a merge the hook refuses because its checks could not run
item: Map the merge hook's refusal 'the merge checks could not run' to a park reason in commands/manage.md step 7 and in the hook's message
motivation: Found by task 68's review (tasks/reviews/068-3.md, outside finding); the gap existed before task 68's branch and it did not change it.
notes: When the hook refuses a task merge because the merge checks could not run (scripts/checks.py, push_hook), neither its message nor commands/manage.md step 7 names a park reason, so the manager has no word to give checks.py consult. The reason is failed (Claude in chat, 2026-11-20; see decided_for_you).
done_means: (1) commands/manage.md step 7 names the park reason failed for a task merge the hook refuses because the merge checks could not run, and the hook's refusal message in scripts/checks.py names the same reason for that case. (2) The hook refuses and allows the same commands as before: no assertion in tests/test_hook_gates.py about which commands are refused or allowed changes, and they pass. (3) The manager tests pass, all of them, and tasks.py lint passes.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-20 in task 68's merge, from the reviewer's outside finding on earlier files (SKILL.md rule 2). On 2026-11-20 the manager drafted done_means, verified_by, may_edit and runs_as from task 68's results; the advisor ruled FAILS (tasks/advice/070-1.md) on a line about a test of a merge whose checks raise, which names the per-check case and not the 'could not run' one, so only the three lines it held are kept. No line covers the owner's choice of reason: the owner names the reason before setting Ready, or adds a line for it.

outside_problems.problem: The merge hook's refusal when the merge checks could not run (around lines 963-964 of task 68's branch) names no park reason.
Step 7's mapping of hook refusals to park reasons has no case for 'the merge checks could not run'.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: FAILS, saved in tasks/advice/070-1.md; kept the three lines it held, renumbered.
decided_for_you.why: The dropped line tested the per-check error case, not the 'merge checks could not run' refusal, and the owner's choice of reason has no line.
decided_for_you.would_change: A line that names the 'could not run' refusal and cannot pass on today's message, and the reason the owner chooses.

decided_for_you.chosen: Claude in chat: the reason is failed, so the advisor is asked first and the check runs again before any merge.
decided_for_you.rejected: permission or your-action (always park), and owner-fact.
decided_for_you.why: The choice needs no owner: nothing only he knows, nothing hard to undo, no change of direction. SKILL.md already puts the same case for another check under failed ('checks.py try-merge ... cannot run (exit 2)'), and the merge hook still refuses the merge while the checks cannot run.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner wants a check that cannot run to stop for him at once.
